rationale: The original short thesis depended on price sustaining below the 5-min VWAP with continued selling pressure, but price has now rallied back to the 5-min VWAP ($33.94) and the position in today's range has expanded from ~16% at entry to 40%, indicating the intraday selling momentum has stalled. The final candle carried the highest volume of the sequence (52,295 shares) closing near its high, consistent with absorption/buying rather than continued supply, and the bid/ask is now printing at $33.98–$33.99—effectively probing the upper half of the session range rather than drifting lower. Staying short with the key structural premise (sustained sub-VWAP drift) invalidated is not warranted; closing preserves capital without the additional friction of a flip, as there is insufficient evidence to take the opposite side with conviction.
